items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Saturday, 31 October 2026 at 11:20am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Nil.


##Synopsis##

High pressure centred over the Netherlands, extending a ridge across the Irish Sea.


##Wind##

South or southeast, veering southwest, 2 to 4, then becoming north or northwest 4 or 5 overnight.


##State of Sea##

Slight, occasionally moderate in the southwest later.


##Weather##

Risk of fog patches in the east of the area at first and again later. Light rain progressing eastwards overnight.


##Visibility##

Mostly good, occasionally very poor in any fog patches.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

North or northwest 4 or 5, veering northeast 3 or 4 later.


##State of Sea##

Slight, occasionally moderate the southwest of the area at first.


##Weather##

Risk of fog patches in the east at first, otherwise fair.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally very poor in any fog patches.
